votes.motion: Commissioner Squire moved to APPROVE the Amended Subdivision Plat, as requested by Pratt Dimond, representing Lance and Erica Stewart for the Lone Peak Canyon Subdivision Amended Plat, Application No. 2024-0074-SUB, based on the following Findings and subject to the Conditions listed in the Staff Report dated October 14, 2024. Findings for Approval: 1. That there is good cause for the amendment; and no public street, right-of- way, or municipal utility easement has been vacated or amended

Commissioner Nixon moved to APPROVE the Home Occupation Conditional Use Permit as requested by Joely Larson, based on the following Findings and subject to the Conditions listed in the Staff Report dated October 11, 2024. Findings for Approval: 1. The proposal complies with the standards for approval found in DCMC Section 9-5-080(E) and potential negative impacts are mitigated through the imposition of reasonable conditions

Commissioner Shirey moved to APPROVE the Conditional Use Permit as requested by Jason Smith, based on the following Findings and subject to the Conditions listed in the Staff Report dated October 11, 2024. Findings for Approval: 1. Reasonable mitigation measures are placed on the conditional use to alleviate anticipated detrimental effects
Commissioner Squire moved to ADJOURN. The meeting adjourned at 6:58 PM
